jobs.description:
Security Manager

United Security delivers integrated security solutions for high-profile businesses, properties, and events.
With nearly 100 years of experience, we've built a reputation as one of the most trusted and established security providers in the country.
Our team takes pride in professionalism, reliability, and protecting what matters most to our clients.

Security Manager Job Summary:
We're seeking motivated individuals - people that are interested in developing a long-term career in the security field.
This is for a Manager role at a high-profile location, where professionalism, situational awareness, and presentation are essential.
At United Security, strong performance is noticed and rewarded, with opportunities for more consistent scheduling, increased hours and pay advancement.
We believe in promoting from within and supporting those who want to grow with us.

Security Manager Job Responsibilities:
  • Provide a welcoming environment and provide needed services for guests
  • Ensure security officers are on post, in proper uniform and following post orders.
  • Ensure proper enforcement of policies and protocols of United Security Services and those of our clients.
  • Intervenes, when necessary, in resolving personnel problems and guides counseling of security
  • Ensures the efficient, effective, and compliant operations of designated site.
  • Perform a variety of security checks and follow post orders as directed by the establishment
  • Scheduling
  • Payroll and recruitment duties
  • Other responsibilities may apply
Security Manager Requirements:
  • PERC Card required
  • Willingness to submit to a background check
  • Some Managerial experience required (preferably in hospitality or security.
    Previous law enforcement or military experience is suitable as well)
  • Ability to stand up and walk for 8 hours
  • Ability to lead and train Security Guards
  • Some flexible availability- shift hours may vary due to occupancy and needs
